item.subject: science
item.stem:
Chitra's school has two overhead water tanks. Tank P is tall and narrow; the water surface in it is 4.0 m above a ground-floor tap. Tank Q is short and wide; it holds more water in total, but its water surface is only 2.5 m above an identical ground-floor tap.

Both taps are opened fully. Which statement about the water pressure at the taps is correct?

options.A: The tap from tank P has greater pressure, because the height of water above it is greater.
options.B: The tap from tank Q has greater pressure, because tank Q holds more water in total.
options.C: Both taps have equal pressure, because both tanks hold water.
options.D: The tap from tank P has smaller pressure, because a greater height of water always lowers pressure.
